purchases.title: Purchases, inventory & COGS
purchases.lead: Supplier invoices, landed cost and what you still owe — the cost side of every sale.
purchases.cogs_help: From the unit cost on sold order lines
purchases.flow_help: Purchases build stock; when an order is sold, its lines' unit cost becomes COGS and is subtracted from revenue.
purchases.status_auto: Payment status is set automatically from the amount paid.
purchases.payment_help: Adds to the amount paid on this invoice. It cannot exceed the landed total.
purchases.empty_text: Record supplier invoices to track stock cost, payables and COGS.
purchases.no_suppliers_text: Suppliers appear automatically from your purchase invoices.
purchases.no_items_text: Items appear automatically from your purchase invoices.
purchases.items_note: Units sold are matched from order lines by SKU (or item name). The on-hand figure is an estimate: purchased − sold.
